title: Mystic Potion Roller Workshop
description:
✨ MAGIC COMES IN ALL FORMS! ✨

Step into the world of potion-making during Queen City Mischief & Magic with our ever-popular **MYSTIC POTION ROLLERS CLASS**, taught by the illustrious **Professor Brandy Pure-Blood**. 🔮✨

Attendees will craft their own **Mystic Potion Roller** (retail value $25), using our **Secret Sorcerer’s Base** made from natural oils and mystical fragrances.

However, the true spellmaking begins when you **ADD YOUR OWN MAGIC** from a selection of **100+ mini crystals + gemstones**, including such favorites as **Sunstone, Amethyst, Obsidian, Tiger’s Eye**, and many more. 🔮💎

✨ MORE CLASSES + MORE SEATS THIS YEAR!

You asked, and we listened! We’ve added **more class times AND more seats at each workshop** for Queen City Mischief & Magic this year.

Classes are offered **every half hour from 11:00 AM through 4:30 PM**, giving more of you a chance to create a little magic with us!

🕰️ **Professor Brandy Pure-Blood will be taking a well-deserved 30-minute break to recharge her magic at 2:30 PM**, then she’ll be right back to potion-making!

✨ FOR ALL AGES! ✨

Kids, grown-ups, families, friends, Muggles and Pure-Bloods are all welcome. There’s no age limit on adding a little magic to your day! 🔮💎

🎟️ RESERVE YOUR TIME!

**These workshops WILL sell out.** Our Mystic Potion Rollers Class is one of our most popular QCMM experiences every year, so choose your workshop time and reserve your seats in advance.

**Last reservation time is 4:30 PM.**

📍 **OVID & LANE**

Downtown Staunton, Virginia

title: Puffs, or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic
description: “Puffs, Or Seven Increasingly Eventful Years at a Certain School of Magic and Magic” is a delightful theatrical production by Matt Cox, presented by the Silver Line Theatre Exchange in special arrangement with Concord Theatricals. This family-friendly show tells the story of the Puffs, a group of misfit students who navigate seven years at a certain Wizard School, overshadowed by a famous boy wizard who saves the world. This comedic tale is perfect for anyone who has ever felt less than extraordinary, featuring area university students aspiring to careers in theatre. While it is suitable for families, it does include scenes of violence, death, and sexual innuendo. The performance runs for approximately 110 minutes, with a 15-minute intermission.
